description: A custom Android view class 'ContinueWatchingCard' that displays a thumbnail, a progress bar indicating watch progress, and a title. Designed for Android TV with focus handling, precise layout metrics, and RTL support. Implements a fixed size card with embedded progress tracking visuals tailored to specific dimensions and colors.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingCard
classes.description: Custom Android CardView for showing a 'Continue Watching' item with a thumbnail, progress indicator, and title. Implements precise layout, focus handling, and RTL compatibility for Android TV apps.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a ContentItem to the view, updating the title text and progress indicators accordingly.

methods.name: applyProgressToFill
methods.description: Updates the width of the progress fill indicator based on the current progress fraction, respecting layout measurement and insets.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts integer density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels based on device density.

methods.name: dpToPxF
methods.description: Converts floating-point dp to pixels, supporting fractional dp dimensions.
